# KEVIN

> A prototype execution layer connecting supported physical devices to AI agents, with device responses and observed changes recorded separately.

## Product and source
- [Product landing](https://kevin-landing-sable.vercel.app/): Korean product description, illustrative workflows and architecture.
- [Technical evidence](https://github.com/sergiobuilds/kevin/blob/4a310d8/docs/TECHNICAL_EVIDENCE.md): Evidence scopes and reproduction steps.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/sergiobuilds/kevin): MIT-licensed source, protocol demos and tests.
- [Detailed text summary](https://kevin-landing-sable.vercel.app/llms.txt): Engineering sources and limitations.
- [Capability evidence](https://kevin-landing-sable.vercel.app/evidence.json): Explicit status, provenance and source links.

The live character app and the static landing page are separate experiences. LED physical operation and home radio listening have maintainer/user-reported history. Extension demos use loopback protocol peers rather than physical consumer devices. Signed receipts establish integrity of bundled records, not semantic task success or authenticated sensor capture.
